# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). In short: be respectful, assume good faith, and keep discussion about the work.

The Contributor Covenant is by the Organization for Ethical Source and is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour privately through GitHub (**Security > Report a vulnerability**), or through the contact on [krysion.com](https://www.krysion.com). Reports are handled in confidence.
